recommendation: Keep the fix as-is. It directly implements the Published technical correction and keeps the duplicated FHIR stylesheet sources aligned for list-table wrapping.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-I R5 technical correction asking that the primitive types table permit long regex expressions, especially dateTime, to wrap so later columns remain visible.
initial_application: No prior FHIR-31486 source reference or issue-tagged commit was found. Current source and CI still used table.list for the primitive types table, and the pre-reconciliation table.list td CSS had no wrapping rule.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini routes datatype pages through datatypes, making source/datatypes.html and fhir.css build-scope inputs. FHIR-38736 had already fixed wrapping for generated dictionary tables using the same CSS properties, but that related commit did not cover table.list. Community and related Jira searches found no conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: Added overflow-wrap:anywhere and word-wrap:break-word to table.list td in source/fhir.css and tools/templates/fhir.css. The change is presentation-only and leaves all datatype definitions and regex text unchanged.
source_changes: source/fhir.css: added overflow-wrap:anywhere and word-wrap:break-word to table.list td.
tools/templates/fhir.css: added the same table.list td wrapping rule to the template stylesheet copy.

related_jiras.note: Already represented on the combined branch; it added wrapping for table.dict cells and supports the CSS approach, but did not decide or cover the primitive type table.list issue.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive FHIR-I technical correction reporting that the long dateTime regex in the primitive types table caused horizontal scrolling and obscured later columns.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes final WG intent for a non-substantive display fix allowing the regex expressions to wrap.

evidence_items.summary: The datatype page routing sends primitive datatype content through datatypes, and source/datatypes.html defines the primitive types table as table class="list" with the dateTime regex row.
evidence_items.learned: The reported table is part of the current build scope and is controlled by table.list styling.

evidence_items.summary: table.list td now includes overflow-wrap:anywhere and word-wrap:break-word in both FHIR stylesheet copies.
evidence_items.learned: Long regex tokens in primitive list-table cells can wrap without changing datatype semantics.

evidence_items.summary: A related already-published reconciliation commit added overflow-wrap and word-wrap for table.dict cells.
evidence_items.learned: The same CSS approach is already accepted for FHIR table wrapping, but table.list still needed separate coverage for the primitive types table.

evidence_items.summary: The CI datatypes page renders the primitive types content as table class="list" and links fhir.css; the current CI table.list td CSS lacked wrapping.
evidence_items.learned: The rendered current build surface still matched the Jira-reported layout pattern before this fix.
